title: Build E-commerce Inventory Tools with Claude Code #Shorts
description:
E-commerce store owners spend hours building custom inventory alerts. Learn how to build narrow automated inventory tracking scripts using Claude Code.

1. Identify a repetitive inventory or order tracking bottleneck for an online store
2. Use Claude Code in your terminal to build a custom CLI or web script
3. Test the script against live store data exports and package it as a paid tool

Tool used:
- name: Claude Code
- endpoint: claude code --prompt 'Build a Node.js script that flags low stock items'
- docs: Claude Code Documentation

inventory_script.sh (bash) - Your terminal directory:
claude code --prompt 'Build a Node.js script that flags low stock items from Shopify CSV exports and emails a daily report'

The catch: APIs change frequently, requiring ongoing script maintenance and error handling

Sources for the numbers:
- Sabrina Ramonov

Real ways to earn with AI, no hype - follow @GSXAutomation

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
